crossRefs.note: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in…
Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high…
Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you…
But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.
He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”
When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

people.name: Malchus
people.line: High priest's servant whose ear was cut off by Peter.

people.name: Peter
people.line: Apostle of Jesus, leader in the early church

translations.web: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
translations.bsb: Then Simon Peter drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.
translations.kjv: Then Simon Peter having a sword drew it, and smote the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.
translations.asv: Simon Peter therefore having a sword drew it, and struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. Now the servant's name was Malchus.
